claims.requirement: Concurrent get calls for the same nonempty string key share one loader invocation and resolve to its value, including undefined. Loaders may return any JavaScript value or promise; cached value object identity is preserved.

TTL starts at successful loader settlement: expiration is the clock value at that settlement plus ttlMs. A value is reusable strictly before expiration and reloads at or after expiration. TTL zero never retains a settled value for a subsequent get.
A rejected loader promise is removed so a later get invokes its loader again.

invalidate(key) prevents an older pending load from installing a value; a later get starts a new load, and an older rejection cannot remove the newer entry. Previously returned promises still deliver their original loader outcome.
clear removes all current entries and invalidates every pending load so an old completion cannot overwrite a later load for the same key.
ttlMs must be a finite nonnegative integer, clock must return finite nondecreasing numbers, and get rejects empty or non-string keys and non-function loaders.
size counts current pending and fresh entries, distinct keys are isolated, and invalidation removes the selected key.
